reviews.title: Awesome app
reviews.text:
This app really helps me to keep up with my water intake! I didn’t realize how dehydrated I have been! Now, I am drinking a lot more water, but still not enough, but I’m getting better!!

I only wished that it allowed for recognizing the intake of my morning coffee! It’s a bit of a nag to drink more water, and the amount that is set is very difficult for me to attain, but I’m trying.

reviews.title: Great Start, Ruined by Constant Ads
reviews.text: Drink Water started off great, with helpful reminders and an easy-to-use interface. Then suddenly, the ads became overwhelming, almost every button I press or page I open triggers an ad. The app has also become slow, making it frustrating and annoying to use. I’m no longer happy with it. Please reduce the ads and improve performance.

reviews.title: Too many Banners, pop ups, ads
reviews.text:
I am trying to use this app and it’s full of things that get in your way to even try the app out. Waiting 30 seconds for ads to disappear, warning message ads about my phone being hacked, and quite literally every time you try to do anything some pop-up slows it down. 

I don’t have time for this, the trial should not be so time consuming or difficult to use. I know you want people to buy the app and remove ads, but while you’re test driving a car, it’s nice if the wheels don’t keep falling off.
